metadata.description: TerraLab MCP for Claude: map data, ready for QGIS.

plugins.name: terralab
plugins.description: Real geospatial data for any place, from a chat: buildings, roads, addresses, land use, waterways, transit and protected areas on an interactive map, with sources and licences, as Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML or CSV. Also GIS file conversion, coordinates and CRS, elevation and contours. No account needed.
